title: Fix muscle group boxes showing zero exercises

requirements.summary: Fix WorkoutLibraryPage to correctly display exercises in their respective muscle group sections
acceptanceCriteria: Each muscle group section displays all exercises belonging to that muscle group
No muscle group section shows zero exercises when exercises exist for that group in the backend
Exercise cards render correctly with their name, image/video, and relevant details inside each section

file_operations.description: Diagnose and fix the data mapping/filtering logic that causes exercise counts to show as zero. The issue is likely in how exercises are being filtered by muscle group - verify that the primaryMuscle field from exercises matches the muscle group name/identifier used in MuscleGroupDetails. Ensure the filteredExercises logic correctly associates exercises with their muscle group sections. Check that the muscleGroup.exerciseIds array is being used or that exercises are filtered by muscleGroup.name matching exercise.primaryMuscle. Update the rendering logic to display exercise cards with images (using frontend/public/assets/generated/ paths where applicable), videos, names, and details inside each collapsible section.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix the data fetching and filtering logic to ensure exercises are correctly associated with muscle groups
acceptanceCriteria: The muscle group identifier used to group exercises on the frontend matches the identifier returned by the backend for each exercise
The React Query hooks return a non-empty list of exercises when exercises exist in the canister
Console produces no errors related to undefined muscle group fields or failed exercise fetches

file_operations.description: Audit the useGetAllExercises and useGetAllMuscleGroups hooks to ensure they are correctly fetching and transforming data. Verify that the Exercise type's primaryMuscle field (which is a MuscleGroup enum) is being correctly compared with the MuscleGroupDetails name field. Add console logging during development to verify data structure and field values. Ensure the query hooks properly handle the MuscleGroup enum values and that string comparisons (if any) match the exact enum format returned by the backend.

Add diagnostic logging to verify that exercises array and muscleGroups array are both populated correctly. Log the primaryMuscle value for each exercise and the name value for each muscle group to confirm they match. Verify the filtering logic compares the correct fields (exercise.primaryMuscle should match muscleGroup.name or use muscleGroup.exerciseIds array). If using exerciseIds, ensure exercises are looked up by id correctly. Fix any type mismatches or case-sensitivity issues in the comparison logic.
